subject: Initiate vendor security questionnaire & clarifying questions — Helix.ai
messages:
From: Alicia Park <alicia@helix.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-15T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up from today's demo — security & next steps

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — the team liked the latency numbers and the routing controls. Security is the next gating item for us. Can Redwood help kick off a vendor questionnaire (our security team prefers CAIQ, but SIG is OK if it's easier on your side)? A couple quick items we need to confirm:

- Do you have a SOC 2 Type II report (or is one in progress)?
- We will be sending over a dataflow diagram; does Redwood need environment-specific diagrams (prod vs staging)?
- We handle PHI for a subset of customers — is Redwood prepared to sign a BAA if required?
- Any redlines or custom security addenda we should expect?

Timeline: security needs an initial completed questionnaire within ~3 business days to keep our procurement window on track. Procurement contact is procurement@helix.ai.

I've attached a short scope overview so you can see the endpoints/data classes we discussed.

Thanks,
Alicia Park
Head of IT Security
Helix.ai
Attachment: Helix-Scope-Overview.pdf
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Park <alicia@helix.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-15T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — security & next steps

Hi Alicia — great to connect today, appreciate the clear priorities. Re: your asks, a few clarifying questions so we can route the right owners and meet your 3-day window:

1) Questionnaire type: you said CAIQ preferred — we can deliver a CAIQ (fully completed) or a SIG-lite prefill. Which would your security team rather receive first? Prefill + CAIQ is also an option if you want both.

2) SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II audit in progress (coverage period started 2026-04-01). We can share our latest audit report summary and control mappings as soon as the auditor finalizes — would a SOC 2 summary + control matrix work for your reviewers now, with the full report to follow?

3) PHI/BAA: if Helix will be sending PHI, we will need to confirm the scope (which endpoints, retention needs). We have a standard BAA template — Lauren (cc) owns BAAs; Lauren, can you confirm estimated turnaround and any common redlines?

4) Data residency: Alicia, do you require EU data residency for any of the workloads discussed, or will US-only hosting be acceptable?

5) Evidence & owners: what evidence types will your team request first (e.g., infrastructure diagrams, encryption configs, access logs)? We can start assembling artifacts; Marissa (cc) will coordinate evidence pulls.

If CAIQ is preferred, we'll start with that and attach our prefilling guide (short checklist) and ask for your security contact to own the review cycle. If you can share the dataflow diagram, we'll map fields to the CAIQ sections.

Next steps (proposed):
- You confirm CAIQ vs SIG-lite and data residency requirement
- Helix security contact to confirm evidence priority list
- We'll send CAIQ prefill within 48 hours once we have the diagram and confirmation on PHI scope

Attaching: redwood-sig-prefill-guide.pdf (checklist + owner map).

Thanks — I'll coordinate internally to meet the timeline.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-sig-prefill-guide.pdf
From: Alicia Park <alicia@helix.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-15T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from today's demo — security & next steps

On Tue, Sep 15, 2026 at 4:42 PM jonas_weber@redwood.ai wrote:
> If CAIQ is preferred, we'll start with that and attach our prefilling guide...

Thanks, Jonas. CAIQ would be best to start — our reviewers consume CAIQ spreadsheets directly. A few clarifications:

- PHI: yes, Helix will send PHI to Redwood-hosted endpoints (we have a narrow scope: user-submitted clinical notes and anonymized device telemetry).
- Data residency: US-only hosting is acceptable for this integration.
- Evidence: please prioritize SOC mapping, encryption-at-rest configs, KMS usage, access control lists (IAM), and audit log retention. Those are likely first-round asks.
- Timeline: 8-week overall procurement window but security needs an initial CAIQ back within 3 business days for the first review.

Security contact: Alicia Park (same email) — I'll be the reviewer for the CAIQ. Procurement will follow up on PO/contract once security signs off.

I'll upload the dataflow diagram to the shared folder; can you confirm preferred format (PNG/PDF/XLS)?

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alicia
Attachment: helix-dataflow-diagram.png
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: Alicia Park <alicia@helix.ai>
Date: 2026-09-16T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Helix.ai CAIQ kickoff — internal owners and immediate actions

Team — quick internal follow-up to assign owners so we can hit Helix's 3-day CAIQ ask: (threading Alicia so she's aware of owners)

- CAIQ prefill & submission: Jonas Weber — I will take the CAIQ spreadsheet and map answers to the evidence Helix requested. ETA: initial draft in 48 hours.
- SOC 2 evidence & control matrix: Marissa Cole — please pull the SOC mapping doc and encryption configs. Marissa, I'll flag which sections Helix prioritized (SOC mapping, KMS, IAM, audit logs).
- BAA & contract redlines: Lauren Bishop — please prepare our standard BAA and flag any clauses we expect procurement to negotiate. If Helix requests redlines, let's aim for an initial position within 3 business days.

Action items:
- Marissa: start evidence pull and note anything outstanding in SIG-142.
- Lauren: prep BAA and share standard language; loop legal if necessary.
- Jonas: begin CAIQ prefill once Helix uploads the diagram (Alicia: PNG/PDF is fine).

I'll set up a short internal sync for tomorrow morning to review the first CAIQ draft. Alicia — we'll share the CAIQ draft to you for review as soon as it's ready.

Thanks,
Jonas
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
